reviews.title: one with the ants
reviews.text: this app is genuinely so useful, i love the concept and design. and when i do go outside to take a pic of grass just to get back on my phone, i end up enjoying nature and spending a while off of my phone. the setup and aesthetics of this app is also just so pleasing and another one of the reasons this app isn’t annoying. thank you so much for making this cause it’s genuinely what i needed as a reminder that there’s more to life than my phone ;)

reviews.title: Finally!
reviews.text:
This is the app of my dreams! All the blocks of telling me to take deep breaths or having me do math don't work because they're too easy! Having to actually get up (*even if it's to go to a window and cheat to take a picture from there, more on it later) and move around gives me the time to be less of a zombie. it's the most accountable i've been with my phone!

Only complaints: it's a little faulty, as expected! Like mentioned, it will register grass from a second story window when I'm feeling like a slacker, but i can be touching the only patch of green plant in my front yard (mint) and it doesn't count. Not a big problem, i just man up and go across the street to freak the neighbors out by touching their lawn instead but worth mentioning, along with that i love to add how poor i am and how much i wish i could buy full version, but even on the free version this app is great as it can target my main problems!

reviews.title: great at first
reviews.text: this app is superb at the beginning! it forced me to get outside and actually helped with my screen time. there are two very easy loopholes i found within a few weeks however; you can take pictures through windows, and you can block different apps and unblock your original apps. i started scrolling by my couch that’s near a window. Also how would i scroll in a car or closed building? i used to have volleyball tournaments that would get very stressful before i found the app changing loophole and it was horrible. for anyone reading this review, go use screenzen (not sponsored or anything) it’s much better and far more practical.

reviews.title: Cost
reviews.text: An app like this should not cost money and it’s insane that it does. Not even just a $10 all time fee, but $4/week. Thats insane especially for an app that RESTRICTS things on your phone. Insane. The free version exists… that’s it… you can block two apps with it which is hardly helpful, as I feel most people (at least I do) have at least a few alternatives to their favorite doomscrolling apps. Whether it be games or just another social media, two is not NEARLY enough for it to be worth it.
